title: The Twilight Zone Radio Dramas
identity_notes: Licensed full-cast audio anthology hosted/narrated by Stacy Keach. GRH contains the complete 176-title radio release set: 155 titles correspond to episodes/presentations in the 1959-64 television run and 21 are special/non-TV radio entries including unrealized scripts, precursor material and original radio stories.

eras.label: Falcon syndicated radio-drama era
eras.notes: Stacy Keach narrates; celebrity guest stars lead newly produced audio dramatizations and original/special radio stories.

historical_context.title: Celebrity-led syndicated audio drama revival
historical_context.description: The project used recognizable film/television guest stars and was syndicated to commercial stations and military radio while also sold as audio collections.

historical_context.title: Classic television stories remade for modern radio
historical_context.description: Falcon/CBS converted classic Twilight Zone television scripts into expanded full-cast radio dramas with new performers and Stacy Keach in the narrator role.

historical_context.title: Unproduced Twilight Zone scripts realized in audio
historical_context.description: The radio project gave audio form to several scripts purchased or written for the original series but never produced for television.
